JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE N S SANJAY GOWDA
ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

It is not in dispute that the very same award that is impugned in these appeals was the subject matter in MFA No.9368/2018 and MFA No.9367/2018 and this Court by an order dated 15.07.2022 had allowed those appeals and had remitted the matters to the Tribunal for fresh consideration.
2.
In view of the above, the impugned awards are also set aside and the matters shall stand remitted to the Tribunal for a fresh consideration.

Since the accident of the year 2013, it would be appropriate to direct the Tribunal to decide the claim petitions within a NC: 2024:KHC:50835 AND 2 OTHERS period of three months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order.
3. Since the parties are represented by counsel in this Court, they are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 13.01.2025.
4. The amount in deposit shall be transferred to the Tribunal and the Tribunal shall disburse the amount depending on the Order that it may ultimately pass.
5. These appeals are accordingly allowed and remanded.

SD/-
